Field.description: One value picked out of JSON, shown as a stat.

pointer.description:
JSON Pointer to the value, e.g. `/queue/length` or `/items/0/name`.
A list shows its length.

oneOf.description: A view or a widget when the data is one, else indented JSON, else text.
A view (`{status, summary, root}`) or one widget (`{type, ...}`).

fields.description: Values to pick out of a JSON response, each shown as a stat.

headers.description:
Other request headers, e.g. `Accept`. No secrets here: use
`token_env` or `token_command`.

lines.description: Lines of text shown, from the top.

markdown.description:
Render text as markdown. Default: true when the response says
`text/markdown`.

name.description: Tile title. Default: the URL's host.

token_command.description: Command that prints the token, e.g. `["op", "read", "op://dev/linear/token"]`.

token_header.description:
The header the token goes in. Default `Authorization`, sent as
`Bearer <token>`; any other header gets the token as it is.

url.description: The http:// or https:// URL to fetch.

entries.description: Shows what a URL returns, fetched again on each refresh: a view or widget in the dashboard's JSON, values picked out of any JSON, or text. Add it several times with `builtin: http`.
entries.name: URL
